verdict.rationale: Carta's own docs cover the pieces of this workflow. A draft option grant API explicitly models grants that have not yet received board consent and approval [carta-docs-22], and the issuer's 409A-derived fair market values are exposed [carta-docs-23], alongside option grant records [carta-docs-20, carta-docs-10]. Nothing shows these joined into one founder-facing flow that routes a grant through board approval and sets a 409A-compliant strike price. missing for 10: documented board-consent routing/approval flow, automatic 409A strike-price assignment, a single end-to-end founder workflow from offer to issued grant, independent or hands-on corroboration.
